subreddits.label: Subreddits to relay (comma separated, no r/)

officialUsers.label: Verified publisher accounts to relay (comma separated, no u/; optional)
officialUsers.helpText: Only verified accounts that actually post. Their subreddits are polled anyway, so this is a second path, not the only one. Dormant accounts (ZZZ_Official, AnantaOfficial) and publishers without an account (Wuthering Waves) are covered by their subreddit via flair. Leave empty to poll subreddits only.
